title: U Mass - Adiponectin Assay Protocol
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xm9fk96
materials: Remove plate sealer and decant solutions from the plate. Tap as before to remove residual solutions in the wells.
Remove sealer, decant solutions from the plate, and tap plate to remove the residual fluid.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute the 10x Wash Buffer concentrate 10-fold by mixing the entire content of each bottle of Wash Buffer with 450 mL deionized water (total of 900 mL deionized water for both bottles).

steps.title: Prepare Microtiter Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the assay plate and perform initial washing.

substeps.instruction: Remove the required number of strips from the Microtiter Assay Plate (reseal unused strips in foil pouch and store at 2-8°C).
Assemble strips in an empty plate holder.
Wash each well 3x with 300 µl of diluted Wash Buffer per wash.
Decant Wash Buffer and remove residual amount by inverting the plate and tapping it smartly onto absorbent towels; do not let wells dry.

steps.title: Add Assay Buffer and Samples
steps.instruction: Add buffer, standards, controls, and samples to the wells.

substeps.instruction: Add 60 µl Assay Buffer to all wells.
Add 20 µl Assay Buffer in duplicate to blank wells.
Add 20 µl Mouse Adiponectin Standards in duplicate in order of ascending concentration to appropriate wells.
Add 20 µl QC1 and 20 µl QC2 in duplicate to appropriate wells.
Add 20 µl of unknown samples in duplicate to the remaining wells.

steps.title: Incubate with Detection Antibody
steps.instruction: Add detection antibody and incubate the plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µl Detection Antibody to all wells (complete all additions within 1 hour for best results).
Cover plate with sealer and incubate at room temperature for 2 hours on an orbital microtiter plate shaker at moderate speed (400-500 rpm).

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to remove unbound materials.

substeps.instruction: Wash wells 5x with 300 µl of diluted Wash Buffer per well per wash.
Decant and tap firmly after each wash to remove residual buffer.
Add 100 µl Enzyme Solution to each well.
Cover plate with sealer and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes with moderate shaking on the microtiter plate shaker.

steps.title: Wash Plate Again
steps.instruction: Perform a second series of washes.

substeps.instruction: Wash wells 5x with 300 µl of diluted Wash Buffer per well per wash.
Decant and tap firmly after each wash to remove residual buffer.

steps.title: Develop Color with Substrate
steps.instruction: Add substrate solution and monitor color development.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl of Substrate Solution to each well.
Cover plate with sealer and shake on the plate shaker for approximately 5-20 minutes.
Visually monitor blue color development; if using a spectrophotometer with a 370 nm filter, add stop solution when absorbance is between 1.2 and 1.8 at 370 nm.

steps.title: Stop Reaction
steps.instruction: Terminate the color development using stop solution.

substeps.instruction: Remove sealer and add 100 µl stop solution (Caution: Corrosive).
Shake plate by hand to ensure complete mixing; the blue color should turn yellow.

steps.title: Read Absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of the plate using a plate reader.

substeps.instruction: Read absorbance at 450 nm and 590 nm within 5 minutes, ensuring no air bubbles are present.
Record the difference of absorbance units (highest Adiponectin standard should be approximately 2.2-2.8 or within the reader's capability).
